name: Copper Sling Coin (Đồng Tiền Tiêu)

arts.name: Copper Flick (Đồng Tiền Đạn Chỉ)
arts.rule: A flicked coin: a quick Physical hit that lays 1 Metal debuff stack for 6 s.

lore: A holed copper cash, weighted with lead; street guards throw them at thieves.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts and Gold Rain: a cheap, quick Metal-debuff source before better arts arrive.

name: Iron Temper Ring (Thiết Thối Giới)
lore: A band quenched in oil and hammered thin by a journeyman smith; it never rusts.
build_use: Any Metal crit build's early ring: a little crit, a stronger Metal buff and some health.

name: Bronze Peal Bell (Đồng Chung Hộ)

wards.name: Bronze Peal (Đồng Chung Âm)
wards.notes: The starter bell at 1.2 times its payload and its per-hit payment, so the price check is unchanged (3.019 of 3.050)

lore: A temple bell recast for the road; every blow that lands on it rings out and fades.
build_use: Boss fighters and Diamond Body builds: a stronger Golden Bell for slow heavy hits, with block that stacks beside it.

name: Woodsplitter Axe (Phách Mộc Phủ)

arts.name: Splitting Chop (Phách Liệt Phủ)
arts.rule: A heavy Physical chop that lays 2 Bleed for 6 s. With 6 Metal stacks on the foe it splits them (breaking 6) and falls 1.8 times as hard.

lore: A forester's axe with a Kim-ore head that never dulls on hardwood.
build_use: Thousand Cuts and Hammer and Anvil: a heavy swing that cashes in a stack pile; Marked Prey rewards Bleed plus Metal stacks on the foe.

name: Whetstone Jade Pendant (Thạch Mài Ngọc Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Keen Edge Aura (Phong Nhuệ Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Metal debuff stacks are 20 % stronger and your Metal arts fire 10 % faster.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 15 % reserved buys up to 15 W (this grants 9 W)

lore: Green jade ground on a smith's wheel until it hums when struck.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts and any Metal stack build: a standing stack upgrade and faster arts paid in linh lực, not in an art slot.

name: Hundred-Edge Flying Sword (Bách Nhận Phi Kiếm)

arts.name: Hundred-Edge Flight (Bách Nhận Phi Hành)
arts.rule: Counts as a Hundred-Blades Canon art. A quick Physical sword hit that lays a Metal debuff stack for 6 s. With 6 Metal stacks on the foe and either another canon art fired in the last 4 s or 4 Temper, it breaks up to 6 stacks (each 3 broken a free 0.5 hit) and hits 2.5 times as hard.

lore: A sword whose blade is a hundred stacked leaf-thin edges; the Canon's disciples carve one for their best.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts: a fourth canon art that Retinue and Wedge count, and a cut that turns a stack pile into a burst.

name: Tortoise-Scale Armour (Quy Lân Giáp)

wards.name: Tortoise-Scale Shell (Quy Lân Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shell at 1.5 times its payload and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (4.711 of 4.766)

lore: Overlapping bronze plates beaten to the pattern of a tortoise's back.
build_use: Blood on the Whetstone: Iron Skin Renewed returns body shield on every Physical art, and the health and regeneration carry the bleeding.

name: Ring of the Returning Edge (Phong Hồi Giới)

effects.name: Edge Returns the Breath (Phong Hồi Khí)
effects.rule: Each crit with a Physical hit restores 0.8 % of your maximum linh lực.
effects.from: single-metal.md (Metal's linh lực keystone, as an Effect on a ring)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

lore: A ring that rings on every clean cut and breathes the strike back into its wearer.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts: a crit pile never runs the swords dry, and Called Blow makes it reliable.

name: Heaven-Minted Coin (Thiên Đúc Tiền Tiêu)

arts.name: Golden Coin Rain (Kim Tiền Vũ)
arts.rule: A quick Physical coin that lays 2 Metal debuff stacks for 6 s. With 8 Metal stacks on the foe or 5 Temper, it breaks up to 8 stacks (each 2 broken a free 0.4 hit) and falls 3 times as hard.

holder: A Gold-root merchant elder at Core Formation or above; otherwise Lost in a sunken treasury vault
lore: The first coin ever struck from heaven's own gold; whoever holds it never runs short.
build_use: Gold Rain: Seal of Full Payment pays arts and wards in carried stones, so linh lực stays full for the ward while the coins fly.

name: Blood-Seasoned Whetstone (Huyết Tẩm Ma Thạch)

effects.name: Whetstone Vow (Ma Thạch Thệ)
effects.rule: Art costs you pay in health are halved.
effects.reads: Art costs paid in health, live
effects.closes: You can never heal above 80 % of your maximum health.
effects.from: single-metal.md, Blood on the Whetstone (its New keystone, as an Effect)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

reserve_arts.name: Whetstone Hum (Ma Thạch Minh)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Metal arts crit more often and fire a little faster.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 8 % reserved buys up to 8 W (this grants 6.4 W)

holder: A Nascent Soul blood-forger of a demonic-path sect; otherwise Lost under a battlefield's bone mound
lore: A stone that has sharpened ten thousand blades and drunk the blood of every smith who wielded them.
build_use: Blood on the Whetstone: Blood Casting lets arts run on health, the Vow halves that bill, and leech and regeneration carry the bleeding.
notes: Spends 85 % of the budget; Whetstone Vow plus Blood Casting are the value.

name: Ironwall Plate (Thiết Bích Giáp)

wards.name: Ironwall Drain (Thiết Bích Chân Khí)
wards.notes: The Common Ward at 1.3 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.049 of 3.050). A standing drain ward for plain Metal and Physical blows, no health spend.

lore: Riveted iron plate over a quilted coat; the wearer's breath runs through it like a bellows.
build_use: A standing drain ward the engine can run, for Metal builds that took a cast ward and wanted a plain one.
notes: Answers: armoury-mind: Metal armour with a standing drain ward at Nascent Soul size; giant-killer: drain-ward armour for Metal; starter-blade: body piece whose ward reads as a drain ward; triple-convert: Metal armour with a drain ward; unique-heaven-purchasing-coin: Metal armour with a drain ward; one-art: plain Metal-damage ward with no health spend. Spends 92 % of the budget.

name: Giantfall Ring (Đồ Cự Giới)
lore: A ring filed from the tip of a broken spear; woodcutters wear it to fell trees taller than themselves.
build_use: Giant-killer: realm pierce and a heavier Metal stack per hit, so a six-stack break lands before the fight ends.
notes: Answers: giant-killer: physical penetration or realm pierce as a modifier; giant-killer: item that raises the Metal stack applied per hit; giant-killer: realm-gap damage ring (pierce is the gap). Spends 84 % of the budget.

name: Black-Nail Needle (Hắc Đinh Châm)

arts.name: Black-Nail Prick (Hắc Đinh Thích)
arts.rule: A quick Physical needle that lays 1 Sundered for 6 s.

lore: A coffin nail drawn out to a needle; whoever it pricks is said to come apart at the seams.
build_use: Curse and status builds: a cheap Metal source of Sundered, with curse-scoped damage and duration instead of Metal stack boosts.
notes: Answers: curse-engine: curse-scoped weapon, boosts scoped to curses and statuses; status-collector: Metal item that lays Sundered. Spends 80 % of the budget.

name: Clear-Mind Jade (Minh Tâm Ngọc Bội)
lore: A cold white jade that sharpens the wits of whoever wears it against the whisper of spirits.
build_use: Armoury Mind: a cheap soul-defence piece for the neck slot, standing in for the Thinned Mind close.
notes: Answers: armoury-mind: metal necklace with a soul-defence modifier. Spends 100 % of the budget.

name: Armoury Banner (Binh Khí Kỳ)

effects.name: Armoury Count (Binh Khí Kê)
effects.rule: Your hits deal 4 % more for each equipped weapon-base artifact you carry.
effects.reads: Equipped artifacts on weapon bases, live
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12, patch 2026-11-13)

lore: A war banner hung with a tassel for every blade its bearer owns.
build_use: Armoury Mind: each weapon in the rack makes every hit heavier.
notes: Answers: armoury-mind: Effect that counts equipped weapon-base pieces and hits more per piece. Spends about 70 % of the budget; the Effect is the value.

name: Ninth-Bell Ring (Cửu Chung Giới)
lore: A thin ring cast from the tenth strike of a bell that only rings nine; it hums the wearer's strokes along.
build_use: Ninth Bell: a plain Metal art-speed ring, so the bell arts come round faster, with a little health and linh lực behind it.
notes: Answers: ninth-bell: a Metal ring or necklace with art_speed_pct [kim]. Spends 84 % of the budget.

name: Earthbind Anchor (Phược Địa Mao)

arts.name: Earthbind Drop (Phược Địa Trầm)
arts.rule: A hooked anchor dropped on the foe: a Physical hit that lays 2 Earth debuff stacks for 8 s.

lore: A ship's anchor with Kim-ore flukes that bite the ground itself and hold whatever they snag.
build_use: Deity Warden: a Metal source of Earth debuff stacks, to sit beside Closing Palm and its 3 Metal stacks in an Earth-and-Metal build.
notes: Answers: deity-warden: a Metal piece that lays Earth debuff stacks, an Earth-stack engine piece beside Closing Palm and its 3 Metal debuff stacks. Spends 88 % of the budget.
